latest_evidence.result: Age-only deletion is falsified because a stuck current LATEST can outlive any wall-clock threshold. Reachability-plus-two-confirmed-generation retention preserves current/previous authority in all tested interruption and stale-writer traces and can safely reclaim persistent unreachable orphans after two successful pointer generations, but cannot absolutely bound orphan count while confirmed pointer progress is zero.

candidate_revision: Adopt reachability-plus-two-confirmed-generation retention only as a safe cleanup candidate; retain never-delete as fail-safe fallback and reject age-only deletion. Shift the next bounded leaf from retention to orphan-creation control because safe cleanup deliberately halts when LATEST does not advance.
tested_scope: Deterministic role-local checkpoint/pointer model with immutable candidate files and one CAS-updated LATEST pointer; traces covered interruption before pointer CAS, stale-writer rejection, zero confirmed progress, and two subsequent confirmed generations. No live deletion or scheduler mutation was performed.

phase1_constraints.quota_note: The tested mechanism is pure role-local repository-state logic over lightweight transport semantics; no optional hosted compute/storage credit or paid execution is required.

conflict_check: No O/O-derived, other-worker, downstream, legacy, aggregate-ledger, other-role receipt/config, or unrelated semantic input was used. No scheduler or protected-primary state was read or mutated.
frontier: Bound orphan creation rather than relying on deletion: test a deterministic per-parent attempt key/path derived from current LATEST blob SHA plus intended next logical revision, with normalized deterministic payload and create/CAS collision semantics, so repeated failed attempts from the same parent cannot create an unbounded sequence of distinct orphans.
After that, test interruption/rate-limit recovery without same-run retry, preserving checkpoint-first/pointer-last authority and exact-content duplicate idempotence.
exact_continuation: Next invocation, after manifest/RUN_LIFECYCLE-first bootstrap and exact authority freeze, read LATEST and r173 only as needed, then execute exactly one bounded deterministic idempotency-key model leaf. Compare unique-per-attempt orphan paths against a deterministic path keyed by {parent LATEST blob SHA, intended logical revision}; require that repeated attempts from the same frozen parent either exact-match the existing candidate or stop diagnostically, never auto-adopt mismatched content, never spawn a second orphan path, and never overwrite a reachable checkpoint. Falsify the design if an interruption/stale-writer trace can create more than one distinct orphan for the same parent or can mutate current authority.
